background: Four unrelated adults share a rented 4-bed terraced house-conversion flat (upper two floors) in an inner-city area of Leeds, near Chapeltown and Harehills. They found each other through SpareRoom and have mostly lived together between one and three years. The kitchen-diner is the main shared space. The landlord is an agent-managed letting company; the boiler was serviced in October, and heating is on a timer that people keep arguing mildly about. It is a cold, dark mid-November Monday morning, and bin day is Tuesday. Rent is split roughly evenly, with bills shared via a Monzo pot.

people.name: Priya Nair
people.persona: 29, British Indian, grew up in Leicester. Staff nurse on a medical ward at Leeds General Infirmary, Band 5, earning about £2,300 a month take-home. Single, was seeing someone casually over the summer but it fizzled. Warm, practical, tired a lot from shifts. Texts in short sentences with the odd emoji, replies fast on breaks and slowly otherwise. Currently thinking about whether to apply for a Band 6 post and about keeping her sleep sorted on shift patterns. Pays £480 rent, sends her mum money occasionally for nothing in particular.
people.routine: Early shift this week: Mon to Wed 07:30-20:00 (long days) at the LGI, then off Thu-Fri, back Sat. Leaves flat around 06:50 and walks or takes the bus. Mostly asleep early on days off.

people.name: Callum Hartley
people.persona: 34, white British, from Wakefield. Works as a delivery and warehouse supervisor at a distribution depot, about £2,000 a month take-home. Divorced two years ago, no kids, sees his mum on Sundays. Easygoing, a bit messy, into five-a-side football and Leeds United. Texts in lowercase with few punctuation marks and sends memes. Currently saving slowly for a deposit but not getting far, and nursing a sore knee from football. Pays £450 rent and has a 2014 Ford Focus.
people.routine: Mon-Fri 06:00-14:30 shift starting at the depot in Stourton, so he is usually out of the flat by 05:30. Football on Tuesday evening. Home mid-afternoon most days.

people.name: Mei-Ling Chen
people.persona: 23, British Chinese, from Birmingham. In her first year of a part-time MSc in data science at the University of Leeds while working part-time in a campus cafe, getting about £900 a month plus a small loan. Single, close with her family and calls home on Sundays. Quiet, organised, dry sense of humour. Texts in full sentences, uses lowercase when relaxed. Worried about a coursework deadline at the end of the month and about covering rent through December. Pays £400 for the smallest room.
people.routine: Lectures Mon and Wed 10:00-13:00 on campus, cafe shifts Tue and Fri 08:00-14:00 and Sat 10:00-16:00. Studies in the library or her room otherwise. Walks to campus in about 25 minutes.

people.name: Dave Okafor
people.persona: 47, British Nigerian, from south London originally, moved north for work eight years ago. Freelance electrician and self-employed, income varies, averaging around £2,100 a month after tax. Separated from his partner, with a 12-year-old daughter, Ada, who stays with him every other weekend at the flat, in a shared room arrangement that works fine with the others. Calm, dependable, a little dry, likes radio football commentary and cooking big batches of jollof. Texts in full sentences, signs off with thanks, and uses voice notes occasionally. Currently juggling a few jobs before Christmas and thinking about child maintenance paperwork. Pays £500 rent for the biggest room, drives a white van.
people.routine: Up around 06:30, on site by 08:00 most days Mon-Fri, usually finished about 16:30, occasionally weekends. This week he is rewiring a kitchen in Roundhay on Mon-Wed and doing a quote on Thursday. Ada's weekend is next weekend.

places: Hallway and stairs at the flat
Bus stop on the main road
